report:
Reviewed the complete operator_calls claim, all six implementation associations, and the sole TODO test entry. Captured the checking design, operator representation RFD and well-known method lookup dependency. Source inspection only; no suites were rerun and no source changes were made.

The claim requires all non-short-circuit binary tokens to retain trait/method semantics through inference, with no token-only operand narrowing/equality; proven primitive and generic cases finish as resolved trait calls, ambiguous/unsupported cases cannot succeed, and primitive specialization is deferred to codegen. The RFD explicitly distinguishes lazy boolean control flow from overloadable operators and reserves scalar lowering for future codegen.

expr.rs routes binary expressions to check_binary_operator. operator.rs excludes And/Or into a bool-checked Binary node and maps every other represented token to a well-known method. The captured lookup resolves ordinary core trait paths and member function identities. The operator checker imports the actual signature with separate left/right type arguments, validates its owner predicate and return projection or bool result, and creates a provisional ResolvedCall containing function identity, static trait dispatch, owner/method arguments and adjusted operands. It submits proof/normalization obligations tied to an expression slot rather than accepting a token as a primitive operation. Probes discard speculative equalities; operand adjustment relates against the method signature, not an unconditional left-equals-right rule. In particular the shape preserves separate Self/Rhs and projected Output instead of assuming they coincide.

infer_ctx.rs attaches recoveries to retained obligations and replaces a failed operation's slot with a diagnosed Error expression, including recovery of a still-inferred result type. Unsupported metadata/signature forms are diagnosed directly in operator.rs. obligations.rs includes recovery scope, canonical goal and mapping in deduplication and limits it to proof goals, avoiding accidental normalization-output or expression-recovery sharing. finalize.rs resolves slots and copies ResolvedCall targets, dispatch Self/trait references and both argument lists into finalized storage; it does not specialize primitive calls back to scalar operator nodes. These are meaningful implementation mechanisms, but they do not establish complete candidate discovery, generic support or every negative-case behavior.

The implementation TODO explicitly states generic operator bodies and unknown-Self candidate hints remain incomplete. The sole associated test checking_body_operator_calls has no assertions and intentionally defers the full matrix: every operator mapping, differing shift operand types, ordinary core primitive impl metadata traces without synthetic candidates, source-driven positive/negative and independent oracle cases, primitive/generic/nonnumeric-shift/user-defined calls, non-Self Rhs/Output, Any-domain preservation before proof selection, lazy boolean forms and rejection of 1 + true. Its prerequisite is completion of the named missing implementation slices and association/review of that matrix. An unassociated local mapping unit test exists in the implementation file, but is not substituted for the associated comprehensive evidence. No runtime coverage or universal operator completeness is claimed. All implementation entries and requirements remain accounted for with the explicit implementation/evidence deferrals preserved, and no additional concrete edits are requested.
